Audit item: squint-ec53337-upside-down

Claim raised by an audit worker: CRITICAL: Quartz bitmap context draws pixels vertically upside down. In Core Graphics the default coordinate system of a `CGBitmapContext` places the origin (0,0) at the bottom-left corner with Y pointing upward, while the raw buffer returned by `CGBitmapContextGetData` lays pixel rows top-to-bottom starting at row 0. `core/src/imageio.rs` passes the `CGImage` directly to `CGContextDrawImage` without flipping the context transformation matrix, so it renders the image vertically inverted into the pixel array: any valid HEIC (e.g. an iPhone photo) comes out as a JPEG flipped along the Y axis.

Audit item: squint-ec53337-hdr-highlight-clamp

Claim raised by an audit worker: `CGContextDrawImage` does not colour-convert when the context uses the image's own space. For a Display P3 source in `core/src/imageio.rs`, `ctx_cs` is the image's `CGColorSpace` and the context is 8 bpc; if Image I/O hands back a `CGImage` with extended-range components, values above 1.0 clamp to the per-component max. A real iPhone HDR HEIC decoded by Image I/O as extended range will clamp and bleed at exactly the highlights the Email preset exists to show.

Audit item: squint-c7ea926-vp8x-flag-clear-safe

Claim raised by an audit worker: Clearing the VP8X flags at `out[20]` in `strip_webp` (`core/src/webp.rs`) is safe and correct. Per the WebP container spec `VP8X` must be the first chunk, so the RIFF header is bytes 0..12, the `VP8X` chunk header is bytes 12..20, and the first payload byte holding the feature flags is exactly `out[20]`. The `out.len() > 20` guard prevents out-of-bounds indexing if `VP8X` has a zero-length payload or is cut short, and `&out[12..16] == b"VP8X"` ensures the flags are only modified when `VP8X` is in the first-chunk position.

Audit item: squint-c7ea926-zero-length-picture

Claim raised by an audit worker: A WebP containing a picture chunk with a zero-length payload returns `Some` from `strip_webp` (`core/src/webp.rs`) with `wiped > 0`, so the `lib.rs` branch never sees `wiped == 0` and happily emits a "stripped" WebP with a blank picture, which `Source::open` then decodes to an image of nothing through an `unwrap_or`-style fallback rather than reporting the blank. `has_picture` needs a payload-length floor.

Audit item: squint-c7ea926-icc-torn-chain

Claim raised by an audit worker: The profile is read through the same torn chain: `icc_profile` in `core/src/webp.rs` swallows the walk's `None` and returns `None`, which is indistinguishable from "this file carries no `ICCP`".
